summary: Auna S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its Annual General Meeting held on June 30, 2026, and a board composition update. Shareholders approved routine matters including financial reports, director discharge, and auditor reappointment. Two directors, Jorge Basadre and Guadalupe Phillips, stepped down effective July 6, 2026, and the board will not fill the vacancies. This is a standard corporate governance update; the director departures are not forced or abrupt. No terms, premiums, dates, or deal mechanics apply. This is a routine current report, not a special situation.
